round1: Marc went 8 for 8 on winning teams and scored 28 points, nailing Boston in 4, Carolina in 7 and Anaheim in 6, and was the only one to do any of it. Jaclyn and Nickall tied for last in the round at 10. Everyone did correctly pick Pittsburgh over Philadelphia, which is the lowest bar available.
round2: Chrissy won the round at 13 for the second pool in a row, and was the only person who picked Carolina to beat Boston. Jaclyn and Stephanie each got 2 points, having both picked Boston, Anaheim and Vancouver, none of whom won.
round3: Stephanie won the round with 15 points as the only one to nail Detroit in five, vaulting from the bottom. Chrissy, Derrick and Marc each took Chicago and scored a flat 3. Derrick has now had the lowest conference semis score two pools running.
round4: Marc and Jaclyn both nailed Pittsburgh in seven for 15 points each. Chrissy and Nickall backed Detroit again and scored nothing. After last year's Pittsburgh miss, this was a rare example of a repeated Cup pick actually working.
overall: Marc won his third pool with 51 points, a mammoth 19 clear of Derrick and Stephanie (32), after a perfect 8 for 8 in Round 1. Nickall finished last at 23 for the first time. Jaclyn, Derrick, Marc and Stephanie all picked Pittsburgh in both 2008 and 2009, and this time it ended their droughts of wrong Cup picks, at ten years for Jaclyn, seven for Derrick and five apiece for Marc and Stephanie.
